excerpt: The settlement process is somewhat complex, as you might imagine when one must identify, notify, and pay thousands of potential claimants. The settlement administrator, a private company that specializes in such work, named JND, has compiled contact information for approximately 243,397 unique authors (66% of authors) and 15,786 unique publishers (97% of publishers) represented in the works list. This is no small task. Recent court filings show that, through October 31, 2025, class members have made claims for 58,788 (about 12%) of the works included in the settlement.
